summary: Correctness and tooling release: package type aliases in vectors, nested payload chains, function-pointer references and Float32 enum payloads now compile correctly, and the CLI gains a project build command and deterministic mode.

highlights.title: Package type aliases resolve inside vectors
highlights.text: An alias to a struct from another package used as a vector element now resolves to the struct instead of silently reading a zeroed default, and the build no longer prints a false unknown-type warning for valid aliases.

highlights.title: Nested payload chains keep their inner value
highlights.text: Reading a value through nested option and result payloads, such as the text inside a result of an option of a string, no longer reinterprets it as a raw number; key-value lookups return the stored text again.

highlights.title: Float32 vector-field math stays float math
highlights.text: Multiplying Float32 elements read from a struct field could silently become integer arithmetic on the raw bit patterns, changing result from build to build; the element type now resolves deterministically.

highlights.title: Calls through function-pointer references work
highlights.text: Passing a reference to a function and calling it directly, through a dereference, or through a rebound local now emits valid code for all three forms; the direct form previously failed to build and the others crashed at run time.

highlights.title: Float32 enum payloads keep their value
highlights.text: Enums whose variants share a payload field name stored 32-bit floats as the bits of a wider value, so values such as 2.5 or 10.0 could read back as 0; the constructor now packs the declared payload width.

highlights.title: CLI: project build, deterministic mode, icon, pinned deps
highlights.text: The compiler CLI gains a project build command, a sequential deterministic mode, icon embedding for Windows executables, and dotted dependency keys now resolve to catalog roots for installed packages.

known_issues: Assigning an optional value into an existing vector element can leave the slot unreadable, and calling a mutating method through a nested field can update a copy instead of the original; both are isolated and queued for the next patch.
Passing a byte vector by reference to Str.from_utf8 can emit invalid code; pass the byte vector by value until the next patch.
Some nondeterministic lowering issues in enum-payload-heavy units remain under investigation; re-verify numeric results per build until they are closed.
